notes: events_kit.png is the owner's kit for the realm's hours (Design Pack 1): the Golden Hour's sunburst gauge in three states, a sheen, the NEXT plate, a sparkle, and the eight hourly icons, all on the sheet's flat navy (8, 21, 30), keyed off it (darkkey, floor 3 for its grain).

hourly/<id> are the icons the server names (liveops.json hourly.table icon: hourly/<id>). Every disc is cut in a square centred on its fitted rim, so the asset's centre is the disc's centre, and every one is one size: rim radius 137 in 290x290 (row five, painted at 161, drawn down). The disc's navy body stays opaque (solid, the rim's radius less one); what breaks the rim (the quill, the pendant's loop, the flag, the rake) keys off the ground by itself.

The gauges are cut round their hourglass, which a template match puts at (166, 212), (467, 212) and (773, 212): dark and half-lit 300x300 centred on it, blazing 318x360 (x 614..932: the half-lit gauge's right spike reaches x 613), its flames reaching 177 below and 165 above the centre. Their body is solid to radius 120, inside the outer rim, so the dark cells stay opaque on any ground.
